title: Non-Panicking RefCell Access
goal: Inspect a RefCell safely without panicking when a borrow conflict occurs.
hints: Look for a RefCell method that returns a Result instead of panicking.
The guard object returned inside Ok must be dereferenced to obtain the inner i32.
explanation: `try_borrow` returns a `Result` containing a shared guard or a borrow error when an exclusive borrow exists. Dereferencing `*guard` extracts the inner `i32` value from the guard. `borrow` returns a guard directly rather than a `Result`, causing type error `E0308` when matched against `Ok`. `try_borrow_mut` fails when other shared borrows exist.
